name: - Dexible
fix_description: Add reentrancy guard (nonReentrant modifier) to fill, or follow checks-effects-interactions pattern to update state before making external calls.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very straightforward arbitrary call / missing validation exploit: the attacker crafts routerData so Dexible executes a token transferFrom against a victim who had approved the protocol. The PoC is short, single-transaction, uses no flash loans or complex DeFi mechanics, and only requires understanding that user-controlled router/target data can abuse existing allowances.
